Tenya Iida (Summer Training).name: Tenya Iida (Summer Training)
Tenya Iida (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Tenya Iida, class representative of Class 1-A in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, who means to carry his brother Tensei's hero name, Ingenium, and be worthy of it, now that the Hero Killer Stain has ended Tensei's career. He runs the class's roll calls under the campus lockdown with new care. Dark-blue hair, rectangular glasses, a tall build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Formal, loud and earnest; corrects on the spot and names his own mistakes first.
Combat Role: Speed fighter and rescue runner; Recipro Burst for the decisive moment.
Under Pressure: Names the rule and the risk, and asks friends for help instead of acting alone.
Tenya Iida (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He broke every rule he lived by to take revenge, and now holds himself to them harder than ever. Motivation: Be a hero who rescues, never one who hunts, and carry Ingenium so Tensei can be proud. Concealment: In Hosu, during his internship, he went after Stain alone; Stain nearly killed him, and Izuku Midoriya and Shoto Todoroki fought beside him to save him; Endeavor took the credit. His left hand keeps a numbness from that night that he chose not to have fixed. He tried to stop the Kamino rescue, then went along only to keep his friends from fighting. Connections: Tensei Iida, retired, the brother he means to make proud; Izuku Midoriya and Shoto Todoroki, friends he owes his life to; Ochaco Uraraka, a steady friend. Knowledge: Knows Stain's creed firsthand, and that it has spread since his arrest. Canon voice & behavior: Lectures reckless classmates from his own experience. Thread: Whether he can be Ingenium without becoming who he was in that alley.
QUIRK: Engine; Recipro Burst is a short burst followed by a stall.
STAGE: After the summer: Hosu, the final exams, the camp attack and Kamino; Tensei retired; a numb left hand.
personality: Rule keeper: Cites his own breach whenever he enforces a rule.
Humbled: Calls Hosu his own failure and lets no friend take the blame.
Rescuer first: Puts casualties before culprits, every time.
Self-aware: Still narrows to one goal when someone he loves is hurt, and now knows it.
Speaking style: Formal, emphatic, chopping the air; cites the rule and his own breach; surnames.
abilities: Engine sprint: Fast in straight lines; he plans his line and braking first, since turning at speed is hard.
Recipro Burst: Forces his engines past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall and he is slow until they recover.
Rescue runner: Carries a casualty out at speed and turns back for the next; the load costs him agility.
Group launch: With a ramp and partners, his engines can power a leap over a crowd; alone he cannot fly.
Roll call: Runs drills, head counts and sign-outs in numbered steps; the class follows without argument.
Fighting style: Hits at speed and passes through, then turns back to pull people out instead of chasing the fight.
Tenya Iida (Summer Training).visualDescription: A tall young man with short, neatly combed dark-blue hair, dark-blue eyes behind thin rectangular glasses, a square jaw and a serious face, fair skin and a solid build. He wears the U.A. uniform exactly by the rules: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, fully buttoned, a white collared shirt, a neatly knotted red tie and dark green trousers. Earnest, steady expression.
